name: SEMCO Technologies Société anonyme
summary: SEMCO Technologies Société anonyme designs, manufactures, and markets components for the manufacturing of semiconductor devices in France and internationally. The company offers electrostatic chucks and associated components for wafers. It serves OEMs, semiconductor fabs, foundries, and laboratories. SEMCO Technologies Société anonyme was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Castries, France. SEMCO Technologies Société anonyme operates as a subsidiary of ECM Technologies SA.
